title: Dimensional Compasses
description: This datapack+resourcepack combo allows compasses to appear differently depending on the dimension they are targeting when locating a lodestone.
body:
This datapack+resourcepack combo allows compasses to appear differently depending on the dimension they are targeting when locating a lodestone.

**Requires a resourcepack**

With this resourcepack it becomes really easy to differentiate between compasses, and removes the confusion of trying a compass intended for somewhere else! This combined with the recent changes to lodestones, makes compass your perfect tool for early game finding your base, or portal back home!

**To update the compass, hold it in your hand!**

Thanks for trying my datapack!
